<!-- THE PROCTOR SCREEN, jmohr.me/proctor. Dr. Mohr, 2026-10-13: "I need a test slide for the
     TAs. It should be one page with the clock. Reminder about electronics to be in bags on the
     wall. Only BA ii plus. Also a reminder to fill on the id bubbles (ommit leadding zero) and
     the exam form. It should just be at jmohr.me/proctor. A clean link for them to use"

     THE CLOCK IS HIS, lifted from FIN3000/slides/class-16.qmd (and class-08 before it), element
     ids and all, so the TAs' screen and his own exam-day deck behave identically. It counts
     down to an END TIMESTAMP rather than subtracting a second per tick, so it stays right when
     the laptop is busy or the screen sleeps. Start/Pause and Reset.

     75 MINUTES IS HIS NUMBER: every form of Test 1 and Test 2 says "You have 75 minutes to
     complete this exam." The minutes field is here so the same link still works for an exam of
     a different length; it is locked while the clock runs.

     NO TEST NUMBER AND NO DATE ANYWHERE. He asked for one clean permanent link, so nothing on
     this page needs changing between tests.

     THE WORDING OF THE RULES IS HIS, from data/course-meta.yml and the test-day decks, plus
     the details he added here: bags go on the wall, and the ID bubbles omit the leading zero.
     Logistics are his; this transcribes rather than rewrites.

     2026-10-13, second pass: "I would like to remove the not on desk of in pocket part. Then I
     want another section of handing in your exam. Show student id, place answersheet inside
     exam booklet". Four cards now, so the rules column is the thing to re-measure whenever one
     is added: the page must still fit a projector without a scrollbar. -->

```{=html}
<div class="proctor">

  <header class="proctor-head">
    <span class="proctor-course">FINA 3000 Business Finance I</span>
    <span class="proctor-tag">Proctor screen</span>
  </header>

  <main class="proctor-body">

    <section class="proctor-clock" id="exam-clock">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img"
           aria-label="Countdown clock showing the time remaining in the exam.">
        <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="170" fill="none" stroke="#d9dde5" stroke-width="26"/>
        <circle id="exam-clock-ring" cx="200" cy="200" r="170" fill="none" stroke="#14213D"
                stroke-width="26" transform="rotate(-90 200 200)"/>
        <text id="exam-clock-time" x="200" y="192" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central"
              font-size="96" font-weight="700" fill="#14213D">75:00</text>
        <text x="200" y="262" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central"
              font-size="28" fill="#1a1a1a">remaining</text>
      </svg>

      <div class="proctor-controls">
        <button type="button" id="exam-clock-go">Start</button>
        <button type="button" id="exam-clock-reset" class="secondary">Reset</button>
        <label class="proctor-minutes">
          <input type="number" id="exam-clock-minutes" value="75" min="1" max="240" step="5">
          min
        </label>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="proctor-rules" aria-label="Exam rules">

      <div class="rule">
        <h2>Electronics in your bag</h2>
        <p>Bags go against the wall. Phones, smart watches and headphones are off and in the
           bag.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="rule">
        <h2>BA II Plus only</h2>
        <p>The only calculator allowed is the BA II Plus. A pencil and your calculator are the
           only things on your desk.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="rule">
        <h2>Fill in your bubbles</h2>
        <p><strong>Student ID:</strong> bubble it in, and <em class="hot">omit the leading
           zero</em>.</p>
        <p><strong>Exam form:</strong> bubble the form letter printed on your exam.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="rule">
        <h2>Handing in your exam</h2>
        <p>Show your student ID.</p>
        <p>Place your answer sheet inside your exam booklet.</p>
      </div>

    </section>

  </main>
</div>

<style>
  /* A projected screen, so the site chrome goes away and NOTHING scrolls: a proctor should
     never have to find a scrollbar to see the clock. Quarto's grid is overridden to full
     width, and the page is pinned to the viewport height. */
  #quarto-header, .navbar, #quarto-footer, .page-footer, footer { display: none !important; }
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
  main.content, #quarto-content, .page-columns, #quarto-document-content {
    padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important; max-width: none !important; width: 100% !important;
    display: block !important; grid-template-columns: none !important;
  }

  .proctor {
    --navy: #14213D;
    --red: #CE1126;
    font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
    color: #1a1a1a;
    height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: clamp(8px, 1.4vh, 18px) clamp(14px, 2.2vw, 40px);
    box-sizing: border-box;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .proctor-head {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
    border-bottom: 4px solid var(--navy);
    padding-bottom: 0.35em;
    margin-bottom: clamp(10px, 2vh, 28px);
  }
  .proctor-course { font-size: clamp(18px, 2.1vw, 34px); font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); }
  .proctor-tag { font-size: clamp(13px, 1.3vw, 20px); color: #5b6472; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
                 text-transform: uppercase; }

  .proctor-body {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    gap: clamp(16px, 3vw, 56px);
    align-items: center;
  }

  .proctor-clock { flex: 0 0 40%; text-align: center; min-width: 0; }
  .proctor-clock svg { width: 100%; max-height: 58vh; display: block; margin: 0 auto; }

  .proctor-controls {
    margin-top: clamp(6px, 1.4vh, 18px);
    display: flex; gap: 14px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .proctor-controls button {
    font-size: clamp(16px, 1.5vw, 26px); padding: 0.3em 1.1em; border-radius: 6px;
    cursor: pointer; background: var(--navy); color: #fff; border: 2px solid var(--navy);
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .proctor-controls button.secondary { background: #fff; color: var(--navy); }
  .proctor-minutes { font-size: clamp(14px, 1.2vw, 20px); color: #5b6472; }
  .proctor-minutes input {
    width: 4.2em; font-size: inherit; padding: 0.25em 0.4em; text-align: right;
    border: 2px solid #c8ccd4; border-radius: 6px; margin-right: 0.3em;
  }
  .proctor-minutes input:disabled { background: #eef0f3; color: #98a0ab; }

  .proctor-rules { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
                   gap: clamp(10px, 2.4vh, 30px); }
  .proctor-rules .rule {
    border-left: 10px solid var(--navy);
    padding: 0.15em 0 0.15em 0.7em;
  }
  .proctor-rules h2 {
    margin: 0 0 0.12em 0;
    font-size: clamp(22px, 2.5vw, 46px);
    line-height: 1.1; color: var(--navy); font-weight: 700;
    border: 0; padding: 0;          /* Quarto underlines h2 by default */
  }
  .proctor-rules p {
    margin: 0.12em 0 0 0;
    font-size: clamp(16px, 1.6vw, 29px);
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
  .proctor-rules .hot { color: var(--red); font-style: normal; font-weight: 700; }

  /* A laptop in portrait, or a phone a TA is holding. The no-scroll rule above is for the
     PROJECTOR; on a narrow screen the rules stack past the fold, so scrolling comes back.
     Without this the last line ("Exam form") is clipped and nobody can tell it is there. */
  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    html, body { height: auto; overflow: visible; }
    .proctor { height: auto; min-height: 100vh; overflow: visible; }
    .proctor-body { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
    .proctor-clock { flex: none; }
    .proctor-clock svg { max-height: 44vh; }
  }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  var ring = document.getElementById('exam-clock-ring');
  var label = document.getElementById('exam-clock-time');
  var go = document.getElementById('exam-clock-go');
  var reset = document.getElementById('exam-clock-reset');
  var mins = document.getElementById('exam-clock-minutes');
  if (!ring || !label || !go || !reset || !mins) return;

  var C = 2 * Math.PI * 170;
  ring.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', C);

  var TOTAL = 75 * 60 * 1000;
  var left = TOTAL, endAt = null, timer = null;

  function fmt(ms) {
    var s = Math.ceil(ms / 1000), m = Math.floor(s / 60), r = s % 60;
    return m + ':' + (r < 10 ? '0' : '') + r;
  }
  function draw() {
    label.textContent = fmt(left);
    ring.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', C * (1 - left / TOTAL));
  }
  function stop() {
    if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; }
    if (endAt !== null) { left = Math.max(0, endAt - Date.now()); endAt = null; }
    go.textContent = 'Start';
    mins.disabled = false;
    draw();
  }
  function tick() {
    left = Math.max(0, endAt - Date.now());
    draw();
    if (left === 0) stop();
  }
  function start() {
    if (left === 0) return;
    endAt = Date.now() + left;
    timer = setInterval(tick, 250);
    go.textContent = 'Pause';
    mins.disabled = true;
  }
  /* The length is only ever read while the clock is stopped, so a running exam cannot be
     changed out from under the room by a stray click in the field. */
  function applyMinutes() {
    var m = parseInt(mins.value, 10);
    if (!isFinite(m) || m < 1) { m = 75; mins.value = 75; }
    if (m > 240) { m = 240; mins.value = 240; }
    TOTAL = m * 60 * 1000;
    left = TOTAL;
    draw();
  }

  go.addEventListener('click', function () { if (timer) { stop(); } else { start(); } this.blur(); });
  reset.addEventListener('click', function () { stop(); applyMinutes(); this.blur(); });
  mins.addEventListener('change', function () { if (!timer) applyMinutes(); });

  draw();
})();
</script>
```
